title: [v3-RC3] After upgrade NO APS SELECTED OR PROVIDED RESULT for the first 30 minutes
symptom: After upgrading to v3, on the loop tab there was a message 'NO APS SELECTED OR PROVIDED RESULT' with Omnipod Eros and Oref1. The loop did not work until autosens was disabled for 30 minutes.
cause: The database was empty and did not contain enough BG history to calculate autosens.
fix: Disable autosens for 30 minutes until the pump has run and enough data is collected, then re-enable autosens. The thread also suggests a fix: let the loop work with autosens suppressed when there is not enough data and show a notification.
evidence_quote: This was cause by the database being empty and not containing enough BG history to calculate autosens
